Compared with plover motifs, cranes are usually depicted with longer necks and legs

definition.ja: 丸みを帯びた六方の輪郭を用いる日本の伝統文様。雪の意匠として古くから着物や工芸に使われ、輪郭を枠として他の花草文様を配する例もあります。成立の由来には複数の説明があり、近代的な雪結晶図から直接生まれたとは断定できません。
definition.en: A traditional Japanese snow-related ornament with a rounded, broadly sixfold outline, used on garments and crafts and sometimes as a framing shape for other motifs. Its precise historical origin is debated; it should not be asserted to derive directly from modern snow-crystal diagrams.

ja: 六方の丸みを帯びた連続する輪郭が一般的な識別点です
内部に草花など別の文様を配置して枠にする場合があります
雪の結晶を示す鋭い幾何学図とは区別し、成立の由来は断定しません
en: A rounded, approximately sixfold scalloped outline is common
The shape may serve as a frame containing flowers or other designs
Distinguish traditional snow-ring from sharp geometric snowflake illustrations; origin remains debated

definition.en: A Japanese water ornament built from elongated, oval swirls suggesting moving or circulating water. Associated with the Kanze school of Noh and found on performance garments, book covers and decorative arts, it differs from semicircular wave repeats through its curling, oval flow.

Unlike repeated concentric semicircles of seigaiha, the streams coil or turn

Associated with Shu (Shokko) brocades, historic examples differ in their grids, pearl roundels and internal ornament rather than sharing one immutable repeat.

definition.en: A Japanese ornament representing a round temari ball wrapped in thread and decorated with stitched geometric divisions. Temari balls appear as subjects in kimono prints and traditional stencil designs. The internal stitch geometry varies and is not a single canonical surface repeat.

en: Look for the circular outline of a ball with divisions resembling thread work
The internal sectors may be radial, floral or crossing stitch bands
Unlike a generic dot or flower, the whole rounded thread ball is the object depicted

definition.en: A Japanese geometric repeat made of three short parallel bars per unit, alternating horizontal and vertical orientations in a checker-like arrangement. It is also called sangikuzushi, after counting rods. The three-line group and orientation change distinguish it from plain stripes or solid checkerboards.

en: Each module contains exactly three short parallel strokes
Adjacent modules switch between horizontal and vertical strokes
The design is not made of solid checker squares or uninterrupted stripes

definition.ja: 織る前に経糸・緯糸の一部を染め分けた絣糸を用い、織り合わせて柄を表す技法とその織物の総称です。糸の染色部分の位置が織りで少しずれるため、文様の輪郭にかすれたような境界が生じる場合があります。幾何模様から絵絣まで幅広く、特定の一図案を示す語ではありません。
definition.en: A Japanese yarn-resist patterning and weaving technique in which sections of warp and/or weft yarn are dyed before weaving. Slight misalignment can produce softly feathered motif edges. Kasuri covers geometric and pictorial designs and overlaps with the wider international term ikat; it is not one fixed ornamental pattern.

ja: 糸を織る前に部分染めして模様を構成します

格子や絵柄など多くの構成があり、一つの固定柄ではありません
en: Patterns arise from selectively dyed yarn before it is woven
Edges may feather or shift where colored yarn segments meet
Many distinct geometric and figurative compositions count as kasuri
